name: Wysa
one_liner: Wysa is an AI mental health chatbot offering CBT-based support, with optional human coaching for anxiety, depression, and stress management.
best_for: People wanting AI support with option for human coaches
Those looking for CBT and DBT techniques in an app
People with mild to moderate anxiety or depression
Employees whose company offers Wysa benefits
not_for: Those in crisis needing immediate care (call 988)
People requiring clinical therapy or medication
Those with severe mental health conditions
short_description: Wysa is an AI mental health chatbot offering CBT-based support, with optional human coaching for anxiety, depression, and stress management.
long_description: Wysa is an AI-powered mental health app combining chatbot support with optional access to human coaches. The AI uses CBT, DBT, meditation, and other evidence-based techniques to help users manage anxiety, depression, stress, and sleep issues. Daily check-ins track mood and suggest personalized exercises. For those wanting human support, Wysa offers text-based coaching with trained professionals for an additional fee. The app is available in 60+ countries and partners with employers and health plans. Research shows Wysa's AI can reduce depression symptoms. The free version provides substantial AI support; premium adds coaching.
patient_summary: Wysa is a friendly AI penguin that helps you manage stress, anxiety, and low mood using therapy techniques. Chat anytime, and if you want, add sessions with a real human coach. It's affordable and available 24/7.

pricing.notes: AI is free. Human coaching is premium. Employer benefits available.

privacy.notes: HIPAA compliant. Strong privacy protections for health data.

seo.meta_description: Wysa is an AI mental health chatbot offering CBT-based support, with optional human coaching for anxiety, depression, and stress management.

faqs.a: Wysa's AI chatbot is free to use with substantial content. Premium features and human coaching sessions cost extra—typically around $99/month for unlimited coaching. Some employers and health plans provide Wysa premium as a benefit.

faqs.q: Does Wysa offer real human support?
faqs.a: Yes, Wysa offers text-based coaching with trained mental health professionals as a premium add-on. You chat with the AI for immediate support and can book coaching sessions for more personalized human guidance. Coaches are not licensed therapists but trained in supportive techniques.

Multiple studies show Wysa's AI significantly reduces symptoms of depression and anxiety. Research published in JMIR demonstrated clinical improvements after 2 weeks of use. It's evidence-based but should complement, not replace, professional care for moderate to severe conditions.

faqs.q: How is Wysa different from Woebot?
faqs.a: Both are AI mental health chatbots. Wysa offers optional human coaching for additional support. Woebot is entirely free but AI-only. Both use CBT techniques. Try both to see which conversation style resonates—they have different personalities.

how_clinicians_use_it: Recommend for between-session support with AI and optional coaching
Provide patients access to CBT, DBT, and mindfulness exercises
Supplement treatment for patients who need more frequent check-ins
Use as step-down support as patients transition out of intensive treatment
clinician.implementation_notes: HIPAA-compliant version available for enterprise. Consumer version can be recommended directly. Enterprise version offers organization dashboards.
